facts.function: vacuum vessel housing and elliptical collector, components of an EUV lithography scanner

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8486 covers machines solely or principally for manufacture of semiconductor devices and parts and accessories; Section XVI note 2 and chapter 84 notes place parts of such machines with the machine heading
GRI 6: 8486.90 parts and accessories is the only subheading, single 10-digit line

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of lithography apparatus; chapter 90 yields to 8486 for semiconductor manufacturing equipment
the article is a part, not the complete machine

classification.rationale: EUV scanner is semiconductor manufacturing machinery of 8486.20; its housing and collector are parts under 8486.90.00.00. N121378 (pellicle, 8486.90) is flagged revoked by heuristic status (linked H266871); cited only as consistent support, the legal text decides.
